pages.html:
Bright Smile Dental
Services Team Book Appointment Contact

Bright Smile Dental Clinic

Quality Dental Care You Can Trust

At Bright Smile Dental Clinic, we believe everyone deserves a healthy, beautiful smile. Our experienced team provides comprehensive dental care in a welcoming, comfortable environment.

Book Your Appointment

Our Services

We offer a full range of dental services for the whole family, from routine cleanings to advanced restorative procedures.

General Dentistry

Preventive care including cleanings, exams, and X-rays. Regular checkups help catch problems early and keep your teeth healthy.

  • Professional cleanings
  • Cavity detection & treatment
  • Gum disease screening

Cosmetic Dentistry

Enhance your smile with our cosmetic services. From whitening to veneers, we help you achieve the smile you've always wanted.

  • Teeth whitening
  • Dental veneers
  • Bonding & reshaping

Restorative Dentistry

Restore damaged or missing teeth with our restorative procedures, including fillings, crowns, bridges, and implants.

  • Fillings & crowns
  • Bridges & implants
  • Root canal therapy

Orthodontics

Straighten your teeth and improve your bite with traditional braces or modern clear aligners. Consultations available.

  • Traditional braces
  • Clear aligners
  • Bite correction

Pediatric Dentistry

Gentle, caring dental services designed specifically for children. We make dental visits fun and help build healthy habits.

  • Children's cleanings
  • Fluoride treatments
  • Cavity prevention

Emergency Dentistry

Unexpected dental problems? We offer same-day emergency appointments for urgent issues like broken teeth or severe pain.

  • Urgent pain relief
  • Broken tooth repair
  • Trauma treatment

Meet Our Team

Our experienced, compassionate dental professionals are dedicated to providing you with excellent care and a positive experience.

Dr. Sarah Mitchell

Founder & Lead Dentist

Dr. Mitchell brings 15 years of experience in general and cosmetic dentistry. She earned her DDS from the University of Oregon and is passionate about patient education and preventive care.

DDS, University of Oregon • Member, American Dental Association

Dr. James Chen

Associate Dentist

Dr. Chen specializes in restorative and implant dentistry. With 10 years of experience, he is known for his gentle technique and attention to detail. He enjoys helping patients restore their smiles.

DDS, University of Washington • Implant Certification

Emily Rodriguez

Registered Dental Hygienist

Emily is dedicated to helping patients maintain excellent oral health. With 8 years of experience, she provides thorough cleanings and personalized hygiene education to all our patients.

RDH, Oregon Board Certified • Patient Education Specialist

Marcus Johnson

Dental Assistant

Marcus assists in all procedures and ensures patients feel comfortable and welcome. His friendly demeanor and efficiency make him a valued part of our caring team.

Certified Dental Assistant • Patient Care Coordinator
